verdict.rationale: Shopify Markets directly addresses this story: selling to multiple markets from a single store, localized storefront previews per market ('View as' customers), regional pricing/tailoring, plus adjacent duties/tax handling (automated sales tax, filing) and B2B/international payments support. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of translation/localization app details and duty/import tax calculation specifics beyond US sales tax, and independent third-party corroboration of multi-currency/duties accuracy.
